# Use Cases

Every use case gitversioned is measured against, and the example whose test
shows it working. They come from four places: what 0.3.1 supported, what
the 0.4 rewrite added, what the markurtz/template generator needs, and what
other release tools offer. The source list is
[`examples/use-cases.toml`](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/use-cases.toml).

## Supported by gitversioned 0.3.1

| ID | Use case | Shown in |
| -- | -------- | -------- |
| V1 | Hatchling version source with a build hook that ships version.py | [hatchling](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/hatchling), [template-python](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/template-python) |
| V2 | setuptools from pyproject.toml | [setuptools](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/setuptools) |
| V3 | setuptools from setup.cfg and from setup.py | [setuptools-legacy](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/setuptools-legacy) |
| V4 | Maturin build that keeps Cargo.toml and the wheel on one version | [maturin](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/maturin) |
| V5 | Print the version from the command line (calculate) | [version-shapes](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/version-shapes) |
| V6 | Write the version file from the command line (write, --output) | [version-shapes](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/version-shapes), [custom-targets](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/custom-targets) |
| V7 | Preview the formatted output before writing (format) | [version-shapes](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/version-shapes), [polyglot](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/polyglot) |
| V8 | Several files in one run: Cargo.toml, Dockerfile, regex overrides | [polyglot](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/polyglot), [custom-targets](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/custom-targets), [docker](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/docker) |
| V9 | Pass the version to docker build as a build argument | [docker](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/docker) |
| V10 | Python API to resolve the version in a script | [python-api](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/python-api) |

| V16 | PEP 440 or SemVer output (version_standard) | [version-shapes](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/version-shapes) |

## Added by the 0.4 rewrite

| ID | Use case | Shown in |
| -- | -------- | -------- |
| S1 | Package builder: the right version in every build with no config | [hatchling](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/hatchling), [setuptools](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/setuptools), [maturin](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/maturin), [static-version](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/static-version), [template-python](https://github.com/markurtz/git-versioned/tree/main/examples/template-python) |

## Out of Scope

These are left out on purpose, each for the reason given.

| ID | Use case | Why |
| -- | -------- | --- |
| V20 | Version from a branch name, a commit message, a file or a function | PRD Q24: tags are the only version source, plus the pin, the archive file and sdist metadata. A VERSION file is served by `version = ...` or GITVERSIONED__VERSION. |
| V21 | User templates for version strings and version.py (ExStr, output_strategies) | PRD Q26: no config value is a template, so nothing in config runs code. version.py has one built-in shape. |
| V22 | Post releases (1.2.3.post1) and the post version type | SemVer has no post releases and the PRD fixes the version shapes. A post tag is reported as a lookalike tag instead of being used silently (see version-shapes). |
| T18 | Changelog grouped by scope first, with a Migrations list | The changelog layout is fixed as kinds then scope (PRD Q11). The template's CHANGELOG.md note describes scope first and should be updated to match. |
| C27 | Publishing to PyPI, crates.io and npm | PRD not-goal: gitversioned stops at the tag. The template's release.yml publishes with trusted publishing. |
| C28 | GitHub Releases with notes | PRD not-goal: the release workflow creates the GitHub release. Its notes are the changelog section, which `release --json` and CHANGELOG.md carry. |
| C29 | changesets intent files | PRD not-goal: git history and PR text are the only inputs. The ## Changelog block in a PR body covers hand-written entries. |
| C30 | GitLab, Gitea and other forges for the release PR | PRD not-goal: release --pr uses gh. version, check, release --write and release --tag work on any git remote. |
| C31 | Hosted bot or GitHub App (release-please, Renovate-style) | PRD not-goal: a plain CLI run from the repository's own workflow with its own token. |
| C32 | cargo-semver-checks in release-plz: bump level from API changes | PRD Q25: the bump level comes from commits, flags and labels only. A diff hook waits for a repository that needs it. |
| C33 | semantic-release maintenance branches: releases from 1.x while main is on 2.x | Open question: release --tag requires a version newer than every tag, which blocks backports, and release --pr only runs on `branch`. Versions resolve correctly on a maintenance branch. |
| C34 | commitizen cz commit: an interactive commit prompt | Not in the PRD; editors and agents write the subject, and check validates it. |
| C35 | Custom commit type to bump mapping (commitizen bump_map, semantic-release releaseRules) | PRD Q25 and the fixed rules: breaking is major, feat minor, the rest patch, chore/ci/test none. `types` only limits which types check accepts. |
| C36 | Custom changelog templates and hidden types (git-cliff, conventional-changelog presets) | PRD Q27 fixed the layout; only the path is configurable. |
